verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own browser configuration docs say that Browserbase-launched sessions can run in one of four regions, letting users keep session data in a required jurisdiction. This covers browser session data only, and only when using Browserbase. Server-side caching of act/observe/extract results is documented with no region or residency control. missing for 10: residency control for server-side cache and LLM-processed data, the list of available regions, any data-residency or compliance documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Browserbase runs browsers in four regions, so you can cut latency by starting the browser near your users or your target site, and keep session data in a required jurisdiction.
